recovery.repair_rule: for each K, choose the lowest production retry offset in [0,255] that decodes at overhead 0 on all three hard schedules crossed with all three training loss roots; freeze the complete map and SHA-256 before validation; no manual exceptions
recovery.attempt_derivation: retry offset r selects public seed_attempt=(base_seed_attempt+r) modulo 256; that public attempt adds attempt*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 modulo 2^64 to the certified GF(256) precode seed and attempt*0x9e3779b9 modulo 2^32 to the packet peel seed; raw phases use r=0 exactly

packet_trace.trace_seed: loss_seed xor (K * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15) xor (block_bytes * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9) mod 2^64; overhead salt and local trial salt are zero
packet_trace.rng: SplitMix64; Unit=(Next() >> 11) / 2^53; drop iff Unit < loss_rate
packet_trace.iid: candidate packet IDs 0,1,...; use the unsalted trace-seed RNG
packet_trace.burst: candidate packet IDs 0,1,...; use RNG seed trace_seed xor 0x10fade; eight-drop bursts start on an idle candidate with probability loss_rate/(8-7*loss_rate)
packet_trace.adversarial: candidate packet IDs UINT32_MAX-2*i modulo 2^32; use RNG seed trace_seed xor 0x10fade and IID drops
packet_trace.repair-only: candidate packet IDs K+i modulo 2^32; use RNG seed trace_seed xor 0x10fade and IID drops
packet_trace.nested_overhead: generate one K+4 delivered-ID prefix; threshold h replays exactly its first K+h IDs
packet_trace.trace_sha256: SHA-256 of the K+4 delivered IDs encoded consecutively as unsigned 32-bit little-endian words

timing.seed_derivation: construction seed is selected by seed_mode and unchanged; loss seed=SplitMix64(base_loss_seed xor (replicate * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 mod 2^64))
timing.confidence: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over paired log seconds
timing.effective_floor: log1p(0.02) after both A/A intervals pass
timing.aa_repeatability_rule: each A/A 95% interval must lie strictly inside [-log1p(0.02),+log1p(0.02)]; otherwise the comparison is non-selectable
timing.production_policy: final timing replays the frozen production repair map; each Wirehair2 timing receipt binds its map SHA-256 and realized attempt
timing.eligibility: a timing cell is eligible only when every compared arm byte-recovers successfully on the predeclared prefix; any arm failure invalidates the timing panel and remains a recovery failure; observed common-success intersection is forbidden
timing.scope_protocol: decoder_solve uses a fresh decoder and the identical fixed K+4 received prefix; encoder_init_plus_first_K_symbols encodes exactly IDs 0..K-1; receive_to_success replays the nested trace and includes all feed and final recovery work through each arm's first success

panel_protocol.order_assignment: phase_bit=low bit of SHA256(canonical panel key); ABBA iff replicate parity equals phase_bit, otherwise BAAB

execution_geometry.cohort_identity: all timing cell fields except replicate and loss_seed, plus panel
execution_geometry.cohort_order: block_bytes order, then K-set order, then frozen panel ordinal
execution_geometry.topology_policy: eight singleton-pinned workers on distinct physical cores; maximize coverage of available L3/LLC groups, then fill deterministically; distinct L3/LLC groups are preferred but not required

statistics.block_log_ratio: ABBA=((ln e0-ln e1)+(ln e3-ln e2))/2; BAAB=((ln e1-ln e0)+(ln e2-ln e3))/2
statistics.independent_unit: one replicate mean over every frozen K in the reported band and width
statistics.aggregate_weighting: within each replicate, equal weight for every frozen K x width cell
statistics.variance: unbiased sample variance over replicate means

timing.invalid_timer_policy: each successful slot sums exactly invocations_per_slot fresh exact-scope invocation-reported durations into one integer elapsed_ns value in [1,2^63-1]; any non-success requires four nulls and makes the complete comparison panel non-selectable; rows are never dropped

architecture_order: form the recovery-equivalent set within 0.1 percentage point of the eligible minimum aggregate overhead-0 failure count
fastest decoder_solve within that recovery-equivalent set
selection.final_decoder_solve_vs_wirehair2: candidate/wirehair2_head paired-log 95% upper bound is strictly below negative effective floor in every band x payload width
selection.final_receive_to_success_vs_wirehair1: candidate/wirehair1 paired-log 95% upper bound is strictly below negative effective floor in every band x payload width
selection.final_encoder_rule: candidate/control paired-log 95% upper bound is strictly below effective floor for both controls in every band x payload width and strictly below negative effective floor for both controls under equal-cell aggregate weighting
selection.final_raw_failure_rule: 100 * failures <= cells overall and in every band x loss/schedule stratum at overhead 0
selection.final_repaired_rule: zero overhead-0 weak (K,production_seed) units on the training census
selection.final_validation_rule: zero overhead-0 weak K units on disjoint loss roots with zero unsupported, construction, fatal, or internal errors; the 1% rule is therefore implied

evidence.freeze_manifest_schema: wirehair.wh2.benchmark-freeze.v1 canonical JSON object; it is the sole arm-roster and artifact authority
evidence.trace_manifest_schema: wirehair.wh2.trace-manifest.v1 ordered canonical JSONL rows of ordinal,cell_sha256,trace_sha256; duplicate trace hashes are valid
evidence.repair_map_schema: wirehair.wh2.repair-map.v1 canonical JSON object with 63999 retry offsets indexed by K-2 and bound to training traces
evidence.canonical_hashing: parse with duplicate-key rejection; accept LF or CRLF input; hash sorted compact logical JSON with LF and explicit schema domain separation
evidence.common_cell_policy: every arm has exactly one result for every predeclared arm-free key
evidence.unsupported_policy: only an explicitly measured routed composite is selectable
evidence.thermal_policy: run under the existing sole CPU/DIMM/EDAC sampler; abort on its configured thermal or EDAC violation
evidence.final_continuity_policy: one joint continuity check must bind final_raw, final_repaired, final_validation, cross_width_validation, and final timing to the same source, host, roster, codec kinds, binaries, descriptors, training trace, and production repair maps, and to the exact development architecture-selection receipt
